sentences.Norsk Flyselskap, vær så god?: Norsk Flyselskap, can I help you?
sentences.Jeg vil gjerne bestille billett til Bodø: I'd like to book a ticket to Bodø tomorrow.
sentences.Du kan få plass på flyet som går klokken: You can get a seat on the flight that leaves at seven thirty tomorrow.
sentences.Det er veldig tidlig. Er det et senere f: That's very early. Is there a later flight?
There's a later flight, but it's full.
sentences.Da bestiller jeg plass på flyet som går: Then I'll book a seat on the flight that leaves at seven thirty.
sentences.Er det direkte fly fra Bodø til Bergen?: Is there a direct flight from Bodø to Bergen?
No, you have to go via Trondheim.
sentences.Jeg bestiller billett fra Bodø til Berge: I'll book a ticket from Bodø to Bergen via Trondheim on Tuesday evening.
The flight leaves at nineteen thirty.
Fine. I'll pay by credit card.
